title: the snip panel reads at a glance: bigger copy and save buttons, a larger size tag, a darker dim
why: The critic scored the F8 snip panel picture 2 (notes/shots/cw-snip-after/91). The findings on the snip own elements: the two buttons were small and looked alike, the size tag was 13px and hugged the frame, and the dim outside the frame was too light to frame the choice. Only those three change; no new control and no new key. Copy is the shared primary button (lime) and save the shared secondary beside it, both 48px high and 128px wide with 16px between, the size tag is 16px and sits 8px clear above the frame (measured, so it never leaves the screen), the dim is .6. Findings about the HUD were skipped on purpose: he wants to snip the HUD as it is.
now: The snip buttons are bigger: copy is the main one in lime and save sits beside it. The size tag is easier to read and the screen around your box is darker.

edits.anchor: pn.innerHTML='<button type="button" data-snip="copy" style="min-width:104px">copy</button><button type="button" data-snip="save" style="min-width:104px">save</button>';
